description: Figure 5 illustrates average “likes” for headlines across several “Most similar group of posts” season-group categories using a vertical bar chart. The horizontal axis contains six categorical bins labeled with season-pair ranges (shown as parenthesized intervals), ordered left to right as (0,90], (90,180], (180,270], (270,360], (360,450], and (450,540]. The vertical axis is labeled “Avg Likes” and uses a linear numeric scale spanning roughly from 400 to 600, with tick marks at regular 50-like intervals (400, 450, 500, 550, 600). Each category is represented by a single light-blue bar with a thin vertical error bar (gray/black) extending above and below the bar top; the bar heights are approximately around 590 for (0,90], about 570 for (90,180], about 575 for (180,270], about 585 for (270,360], about 590 for (360,450], and about 590–595 for (450,540]. The bars are not shown as explicitly sorted by value; they follow the left-to-right category order, and no individual bar appears specially highlighted beyond the uniform color and the presence of error bars.
